maya (Docs): Quick thread: customer flagged inconsistent voice in Private deployment docs and missing accessible SDK example. Can we align wording + add snippet?
kevin (Eng): I can draft a tiny snippet that returns plain_text for TTS and a structured bullets array for navigation.
asha (Product): Product asks that marketing pages use 'Redwood' but how-tos can use 'we'. Keep it in the style guide.
jonathan (DevEx): Proposal: add three rules to style guide: (1) 'Redwood' for product capability descriptions, (2) 'we' in step-by-step guides, (3) avoid absolutes. I'll add a lint rule to flag deviations.
luis (Legal): Please avoid absolute claims like "guaranteed private". Use qualifiers such as "designed to" or "intended to". I'll review glossary changes.
maya (Docs): Action items: update docs/style/voice.md, add JS/Python/Go snippets demonstrating accessible outputs, and sweep glossary entries for private/dedicated/hosted. Volunteers?
kevin (Eng): I'll push JS and Python examples. Sample JS:
```js
// Accessible output pattern
const r = await redwood.generate({model: 'rw-1-large', input: 'Provide short bullets for assistive tech', format: 'json'});
console.log(r.plain_text); // TTS / screen reader
console.log(r.structured?.bullets || []); // keyboard nav
```
jonathan (DevEx): I'll add Go snippet and a small CI lint to flag 'we' vs 'Redwood' inconsistencies.
docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/498 (maya)
maya (Docs): Timeline: PRs by Friday EOD. Kevin/Jonathan please link snippet branches to the PR. Luis will review glossary after first pass.
kevin (Eng): ETA snippets Thu morning.
jonathan (DevEx): Lint rule PR Thu afternoon.
maya (Docs): Thanks everyone — ping this thread if blocked. :white_check_mark:
